answer.answer: The archive holds two different reported revenue figures for AAPL for the period ending 2007-09-29, from two separate SEC filings using the same concept (us-gaap:SalesRevenueNet). The first filing (10-K, accession 0001193125-09-214859) reports revenue of $24,006,000,000. The second filing (10-K/A, accession 0001193125-10-012091) reports revenue of $24,578,000,000. Both observations are marked SOURCE_REPORTED and UNVERIFIABLE, with a PARTIAL mapping to the revenue metric. ST-EVA has not selected one figure over the other; the ambiguity is recorded as MULTIPLE_FILINGS with NO_WINNER_SELECTED.
uncertainties: Which filing represents the final or restated figure is not established by the evidence held. The two values differ by $572 million.
